_meta.coverage_metric: planted hollow receipt, cross-forge state, forged/stale merge-admit and unbound export tree detection
_meta.purpose: Prove that GitLab delivery receipts, the merge-authority preflight and the GitHub/GitLab separation all fail closed without network access.
_meta.mutation_checked: 2026-08-07: thirteen injected defects each turned the suite red -- auto-merge default dropped, Owner access level lowered, admit staleness ignored, not-computed status folded into refusal, cross-forge field guard disabled, cross-forge snapshot guard disabled, export tree drift accepted, blocked-interval start disabled, `Part of` treated as closing, UNMATERIALIZED gate disabled, /-/work_items/ alias removed, execpolicy prefix widened, rule filename moved into the github- namespace.
_meta.found_by_mutation: Two of those started green and were real gaps: the `Part of` fixture happened to reference only the PRD, so nothing changed when the keyword was widened; and one mutation never applied. Both the fixture and the mutation were fixed rather than the finding waved off.
_meta.found_by_live_dry_run: The live fetch dry-run against a real 3-segment project showed an unresolvable board URL falling back to a nameless placeholder -- a green receipt pointing at a board nobody has. resolve_board() now exits explicitly and is covered offline.

covers: complete receipt with /-/ URLs and the /-/work_items/ issue alias
missing artifact is failure rather than skip
a single-slash project path is refused: GitLab nests groups
runnable.expected: good PASS and hollow UNMATERIALIZED FAIL

covers: a github-delivery-registry schema is refused, naming the other skill
a github_repo field beside valid gitlab_* keys is refused, not ignored
a github.com URL inside a GitLab receipt is refused
a GitHub merge-gate snapshot cannot replay through the GitLab gate
runnable.expected: every cross-forge fixture exits non-zero and names the cause

covers: merge-admit applied by a Developer (access_level 30) is refused
a personal namespace owner is admitted without a members entry
admit that predates the head commit is stale, not valid
ci_still_running is a policy choice; unchecked is a retry; they read differently
nothing admitted exits 3, distinct from a layer refusing with 1
a PreToolUse hook that exits 2 refuses the run on the active host only
the built merge command always carries --auto-merge=false and --sha
runnable.expected: good PREFLIGHT GREEN; hollow blocked at L1; empty exits 3; blocking hook exits 1

runnable.hollow_fixture: same snapshot with a mismatched export tree and an unknown remote head
covers: metrics derive from label/state events, not restated registry values
Closes #N accepts a slice; Part of #N starts one without accepting it
first_pass_rate is an explicit absence with a reason, never zero
export-tree-drift and remote-head-unverifiable are separate blockers
an unresolvable board URL exits instead of becoming a nameless placeholder
what sync writes survives the zero-network check gate it feeds
runnable.expected: aligned export yields no blockers and passes check; drift, unknown head and unresolvable board each name their own cause

covers: project-scoped and host-scoped prefix rule
narrowness measured by negative controls: other project, other host, reordered argv, glab repo delete, glab mr close, and gh pr merge all refused
positive control uses the exact argv land builds, not a shorter form
rule never lands in the github-merge-* namespace
existing rule is backed up, never lost
unnamespaced project, path traversal, bad host and relative rules-dir refused before anything is written
